task_world.public_context: The UI is an accommodation placement workflow for case access_case_804. It should support candidate search and selection for the live case while keeping helper checks, trial states, blocked alternatives, pending work, and final closure visually separate. For Exam Accommodation Scheduling Board, preserve the education operating context. UI shape: calculator plus staged action rail.

difficulty_profile.operation_family_label: Search, Filter, Detail Lookup, and Selection
difficulty_profile.schema_fidelity: Read tools return plain state objects; write tools return success/error wrappers and operation objects.
difficulty_profile.tool_selection_noise: Each task includes cached, estimate, advisory, fast-track, shadow, same-domain near-miss, optimistic-status, stale-token, draft-receipt, and phrase-validation tools that are not authoritative for the requested workflow.
difficulty_profile.state_pressure: Turns combine no-write comparisons, scoped writes, rollback/recovery/handoff paths, fresh readback after mutation, conflict-source arbitration, and final evidence-chain reconstruction.

mechanism_mix.label: end-to-end evidence chain closeout
mechanism_mix.eval_focus: The final view must reconstruct the path from initial review through dry run, write/recovery, readback, and unresolved blockers.

mechanism_mix.label: conflicting-source arbitration
mechanism_mix.eval_focus: The UI must distinguish current case state from cached, shadow, optimistic, or draft helper evidence.

validation_scenarios.name: search_filter_select turn 1

turns.prompt: Create an operator workbench for Exam Accommodation Scheduling Board, case access_case_804. The workflow is a accommodation placement workflow for education / accessibility, so the interface should read like an operator console rather than a generic form. For this turn, search and filter candidate records, inspect the leading match, and stage a selection without saving it yet. Present the math or eligibility result for access_case_804 beside a staged action rail so estimate, preview, and applied state stay distinct. Make access_case_804 show five distinct layers: current state, allowed path, blocked path, secondary reference material, and closeout status. For access_case_804, broad search results and near matches should remain candidates until the selected set is saved and read back. For access_case_804, older mirrors, estimates, drafts, and queue notes may be context, while the primary status stays tied to the current case record. Case emphasis for access_case_804: preserve the accommodation placement workflow vocabulary from current case records; separate education continuity evidence from final closure. Open access_case_804 in review mode: suggest a next step, but do not show final completion yet.

Extend Exam Accommodation Scheduling Board, case access_case_804, with a no-change verification pass. The user is handling a accommodation placement workflow in education / accessibility; keep the operating context present while separating current state from planned work. For this turn, rehearse the filter and comparison path across open, restricted, and locked candidates with no saved selection. Use a calculation panel and step rail for Exam Accommodation Scheduling Board, with each stage showing whether it only planned work or changed the case. Keep current case status, blocked alternatives, trial calculations, pending work, and closeout readiness in separate visual zones for access_case_804. For access_case_804, broad search results and near matches should remain candidates until the selected set is saved and read back. If secondary references disagree with the current case view for access_case_804, show the disagreement without blending it into completion state. Case emphasis for access_case_804: preserve the accommodation placement workflow vocabulary from current case records; separate education continuity evidence from final closure. Show Exam Accommodation Scheduling Board as a rehearsal, with a run log of checked facts and a clear statement that the case stayed unchanged.
